rows: I am passionate about STEM and want to explore engineering.
I enjoy building robots and want to deepen my knowledge.
Application for the Fall 2025 STEM enrichment program for middle and high school students.
Scholarship application for students pursuing arts and music.
Intensive coding bootcamp application for high school students.
Upload an official copy of your most recent school transcript.
Request a recommendation from a current teacher.
Upload a PDF sample of your artistic work.
